Subject: Intro + quick demo? Trellis Health inference use case

Hi Claire / Raj,

Thanks again for taking the time last week — really enjoyed the conversation about how Trellis is trying to speed up chart summarization and coding suggestions in clinician workflows. Based on what you described I think Redwood Inference could materially reduce token costs and CPU latency for real-time assist use cases.

Would you have 30 minutes next week for a short technical demo and a quick look at cost/latency tradeoffs? I can bring our solutions engineer; we can show an end-to-end request -> response trace and some realistic QPS estimates. Proposed slots: Tue 1/20 10am PT, Wed 1/21 2pm PT, or Thu 1/22 11am PT.

If none of those work, tell me a couple windows that do and I’ll set it up.

Thanks,
Ben

Hi Ben,

Appreciate the follow-up and the proposed times. Heads up on a roadmap change here: leadership pushed a regulatory-compliance sprint through Q1 to handle a vendor attestation and some data-handling work. That means our ML/inference initiative is being deprioritized for the next 6–8 weeks while we lock down compliance work and travel obligations take a chunk of the product team.

Can we pause the demo scheduling for now? I don’t want to ghost you — we still think this is interesting, but it won’t be actionable on our side until we clear the sprint. I’ll share our internal deck summarizing the shift (attached) so you have context. Would it be okay if I ping you in early March to re-evaluate timing?

Best,
Claire
Claire Zhao
Director, Product Operations | Trellis Health
claire.zhao@trellishealth.com
Attachment: Roadmap-Shift-Deck.pdf (pdf, 1.2 MB)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Trellis roadmap shift — next steps

Ben / Monica,

Looping you both in on Claire’s note. TL;DR: Trellis has reallocated the ML effort to a compliance sprint; they want to pause scheduling for ~6–8 weeks.

Action items I recommend:
- Ben, mark DL-4721 as "paused" in HubSpot and set a follow-up task for 2026-03-02 (6 weeks). Use the cadence tag "pause:compliance_sprint" so CS and AE can see it.
- Monica, make a short one-pager (internal) capturing the blockers they listed (attestation + data handling) and any materials we can share proactively (SOC2 overview, private deployment notes). Put the draft in the Deal > Files so we can attach to Claire when we re-engage.
- Don’t offer credits or discounts proactively — this is a reprioritization, not a technical objection. If they ask for an exception we can circle back to me.

We should also archive the provisional calendar invite so we don't spam them; Ben, can you send a quick note acknowledging the pause and offering a hard date window to reconvene? Keep it light and keep the door open.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Director, EMEA & Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Hi Claire — thanks for the note and for sharing the context (totally understandable).

No problem at all — we’ll pause scheduling on our side. I’ve updated HubSpot (DL-4721) with "pause:compliance_sprint" and set a follow-up reminder for the first week of March. I’ll also remove the provisional invite so your calendar stays clean.

When it makes sense, would you prefer I reach out the week of Mar 2 or the week of Mar 16? I can pencil both windows and we can lock something once your team has bandwidth.

If it helps in the interim, I can send a short note with our SOC 2 overview and a one-page summary of private deployment options to share with your compliance team — no demo required.

Thanks again and good luck with the sprint.

Ben
